label: Test Dress 4 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 4
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, decimated directly from the dense textured scan (5.0M faces to 100k, keeping RealityScan's own UVs and texture at 4K) via garment-capture-pipeline/decimate_dense_textured.py. This scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention (unlike Test Dress 0/1's Y-up), so a -90 deg rotation about X was applied. The retopologize-and-rebake route used for Test Dress 0-3 was tried first and produced smeared texture and black blocks on the center-front placket, so it was replaced for this garment. model3d_rotationY set to 180 (confirmed 2026-09-23 via visual check) to face forward.
